# Test bolero get with the work pattern.

# bolero get work gets dependencies to satisfy missing imports in the
# main modules' package graph. Before the 'work' pattern existed, users
# would have to run './...' in the root of the work (main) module.
cp go.mod go.mod.orig
bolero get work
cmp go.mod go.mod.want

# 'bolero get work' and 'bolero get all' behave very differently. Because
# 'all' evaluates to work packages but also to their dependencies,
# 'bolero get all' will run the 'get' logic on all the dependency module
# packages, bumping all their modules to the latest versions.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero get all
cmp go.mod go.mod.all.want
-- go.mod --
module example.com/a

go 1.25
-- go.mod.want --
module example.com/a

go 1.25

require rsc.io/quote v1.5.2

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect
	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect
)
-- go.mod.all.want --
module example.com/a

go 1.25

require rsc.io/quote v1.5.2

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.3.0 // indirect
	rsc.io/sampler v1.99.99 // indirect
)
-- a.go --
package a

import _ "rsc.io/quote"
